editorial_notes: Applied strict de-duplication: one pick per underlying announcement, prioritizing official pressrooms and concrete, material facts. Excluded generic event previews/opening roundups, session-only notices/panels, media-partner items, mere attendance mentions, and social-only claims. Where ecosystem/delegation items were retained, they included concrete product launches, structured programs (e.g., soft-landing, demo days), or measurable expansion outcomes. DeepFest assignments were used for AI governance, infra, agentic systems, enterprise AI, robotics/autonomy and related items; Both used for cross-over AI infra/academy and schedule changes. 99 defensible stories met criteria; remaining candidates largely duplicated selected announcements or fell into excluded categories, leaving a gap of 1. Final gap filled by independently verified MHRSD digital beneficiary-services and MoU announcement.
